title: Vaultwarden
description: Bitwarden-compatible password manager server, light enough for one host.

fields.name: domain
fields.label: Public URL
fields.help: The URL clients will use, including the scheme. Vaultwarden refuses some features when this is wrong.

fields.name: admin_token
fields.label: Admin token
fields.help: Opens /admin. Treat it as a root password for every vault on this server.

fields.name: signups_allowed
fields.label: Allow sign-ups
fields.help: Leave this off once your own account exists, or anyone who finds the URL can register.

fields.name: data_volume
fields.label: Data volume
fields.help: Every vault lives here. Back it up.

notes: Vaultwarden must be behind HTTPS for browser clients to work; put it behind Caddy or Traefik. Sign-ups are {{signups_allowed}} — create your account, then turn them off.
